---
title: "03.Calculate_cpm"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-28"
output: html_document
---

Read-based resistome: ResFinder hits per sample, aggregated to gene level and normalised to CPM.

**Reads are mapped against the full, unclustered ResFinder database** (`resfinder_hits_matrix_unclustered.tsv`,
707 variants) and the hits are then summed by CD-HIT cluster. Mapping against the clustered database instead
(one representative per cluster) forces reads from related variants onto whichever variant happens to be the
representative, which redistributes counts between mosaic genes: comparing the two, 90.6 % of gene x sample
cells are identical (Pearson 0.994) but tet(O/W/32/O), tet(O/W), tet(X3) and erm(T) move by factors of 0.15 to
5.2. It also creates hits for clusters that no read actually supports: FloR, blaCTX-M-137 and blaSHV-100 were
"detected" in 2, 1 and 3 samples with the clustered database and in none with the full one.

Aggregation: each variant is assigned its **gene family** (`gene_family` in `phenotypes_cluster.tsv`, built by
`00` from the CD-HIT 90 % clusters, with the naming rule and the manual curation documented in
`Data/Docs/Gene_family_curation.md`) and hits are summed by family. The assignment is per variant, so the one
curation made per variant (SHV variants split from the LEN cluster) is respected.

CPM = hits x 1e6 / host-filtered read pairs.

**Rarefied richness.** Sequencing depth spans 13.5 to 99 M read pairs and the median differs between diet
groups (Kruskal p = 0.026), while ARG richness correlates with depth (rho = 0.33). Every model already carries
log10 depth, but a single linear term assumes the accumulation curve is log-linear over a 7-fold range. So a
depth-independent richness is also computed by **binomial thinning of the hit table** to the shallowest sample,
averaged over 20 draws. This is the count-table equivalent of rarefaction (what `vegan::rrarefy` does) rather
than subsampling the raw reads and re-mapping, which would need the original FASTQ files; it is a good
approximation because ARG hits are a tiny fraction of all reads.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(vegan)

clstr_name_length <- 19
n_draws <- 20
set.seed(1)
```

# Load data

```{r load data}
hits <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Counts", "resfinder_hits_matrix_unclustered.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
clusters <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "phenotypes_cluster.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(hits$gene),
          !anyDuplicated(metadata$sample_id),
          !anyNA(metadata$reads))

cat("Variants mapped:", nrow(hits), "| samples:", ncol(hits) - 1, "\n")
```


# Sample filtering

```{r sample filtering}
sequenced_samples <- setdiff(colnames(hits), "gene")

common_samples <- intersect(sequenced_samples, metadata$sample_id)

cat("\nSamples sequenced:", length(sequenced_samples), "\n")
cat("\nFFQ valid samples:", length(metadata$sample_id), "\n")
cat("\nCommon samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")

cat("\nSamples sequenced but not valid in FFQ:\n", setdiff(sequenced_samples, metadata$sample_id))
cat("\nSamples valid in FFQ but not sequenced:\n", setdiff(metadata$sample_id, sequenced_samples))

hits <- hits %>% select(gene, all_of(common_samples))
```


# Variant to gene family

```{r hits by gene}
variant_map <- tibble(gene = hits$gene) %>%
  mutate(cluster_gene = str_sub(gene, 1, clstr_name_length)) %>%
  left_join(clusters %>% distinct(cluster_gene, cluster, gene_family), by = "cluster_gene", relationship = "one-to-one")

stopifnot(!anyNA(variant_map$gene_family))
cat("Variants assigned:", nrow(variant_map), "| clusters:", n_distinct(variant_map$cluster),
    "| gene families:", n_distinct(variant_map$gene_family), "\n")

hits_gene <- hits %>%
  mutate(gene_family = variant_map$gene_family) %>%
  select(-gene) %>%
  group_by(gene_family) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

cat("Gene families after aggregation:", nrow(hits_gene),
    "| detected in at least one sample:", sum(rowSums(hits_gene[-1]) > 0), "\n")

# How many variants collapse into each gene family
variant_map %>%
  count(gene_family, name = "variants") %>%
  count(variants, name = "gene_families") %>%
  head()
```


# Calculate CPM

CPM = hits * 1e6 / Reads

```{r CPM}
reads <- setNames(metadata$reads, metadata$sample_id)

cpm_gene <- hits_gene %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_family, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "hits") %>%
  mutate(CPM = hits * 1e6 / reads[sample_id]) %>%
  select(-hits) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id, values_from = CPM) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(-gene_family)) > 0)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(cpm_gene)[-1], common_samples),
          !anyNA(cpm_gene))
```


# Rarefied richness

```{r rarefaction}
count_matrix <- hits_gene %>%
  select(gene_family, all_of(common_samples)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_family") %>%
  as.matrix()

rarefaction_depth <- min(reads[common_samples])
keep_probability <- rarefaction_depth / reads[colnames(count_matrix)]
cat("Rarefying to", round(rarefaction_depth / 1e6, 1), "M read pairs over", n_draws, "draws\n")

draws <- replicate(n_draws, {
  thinned <- matrix(rbinom(length(count_matrix), as.vector(count_matrix),
                           rep(keep_probability, each = nrow(count_matrix))),
                    nrow = nrow(count_matrix), dimnames = dimnames(count_matrix))
  colSums(thinned > 0)
})

rarefied <- tibble(sample_id = colnames(count_matrix), richness_rarefied = rowMeans(draws))
```


# ARG metrics

Shared by every analysis part:

* ARG load = log(total CPM)
* richness = number of gene families detected
* richness_rarefied = gene families detected at a common sequencing depth
* Simpson diversity of gene family CPMs

```{r ARG metrics}
arg_mat <- cpm_gene %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_family") %>%
  t()

arg_metrics <- tibble(sample_id = rownames(arg_mat),
                      total_ARG_CPM = rowSums(arg_mat),
                      log_ARG_load = log(total_ARG_CPM),
                      richness = specnumber(arg_mat),
                      simpson = diversity(arg_mat, index = "simpson")) %>%
  left_join(rarefied, by = "sample_id")

stopifnot(!anyNA(arg_metrics))

arg_metrics %>%
  summarise(across(c(total_ARG_CPM, richness, richness_rarefied, simpson), median))
cat("Spearman richness vs depth:",
    round(cor(arg_metrics$richness, reads[arg_metrics$sample_id], method = "spearman"), 3),
    "| rarefied vs depth:",
    round(cor(arg_metrics$richness_rarefied, reads[arg_metrics$sample_id], method = "spearman"), 3), "\n")
```

# Save Results
```{r save results}
write_tsv(cpm_gene, here("Data", "Processed", "cpm_gene_GPH.tsv"))
write_tsv(arg_metrics, here("Data", "Processed", "arg_metrics.tsv"))
```
